name: channel_ingest_distill_user
content: Distill this {channel} thread update using information-brief contract v2. Respond with ONLY the JSON object.

variables.name: channel
variables.description: Provider-neutral channel word for the message ('email' | 'chat' | 'message').

variables.name: header_document
variables.description: Persisted metadata header built by channel_assist::assist::content::build_header_document; it never contains a raw body.
examples:
Subject: Rewards policy update
From: Example Bank <notices@example.test>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:00:00+00:00
Direction: inbound

variables.name: content
variables.description: Synthetic or live new message content, or a bounded same-thread newest-first batch. It exists in process memory only and is discarded after local distillation.
examples: From July 1, reward points on brand vouchers are capped at 5,000 points per month.

variables.name: content_truncated
variables.description: Whether the supplied content contains only the beginning of the available message or thread batch.

metadata.description: User prompt paired with channel_ingest_distill_system v1.1.0 for provider-neutral information-brief v2 extraction.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.1.1: Replaces a Rust-authored truncation sentence with an explicit managed boolean prompt field.
